next_step_summary: PR #233 is an explicitly product-owner-authorized bounded research exception following merged PR #232. It wires the targeted-region Surya benchmark into a reproducible CPU-only Cloud Run container fixed to me-west1, with one loopback llama.cpp backend configured for four slots, 49152 total context tokens, eight CPU threads, and no GPU; one reused Surya predictor; per-request client parallelism restricted to 1, 2, or 4; bounded PNG/header input; aggregate-only output; and fail-closed temporary-file cleanup. The service template remains benchmark-only at 8 vCPU, 16 GiB, minScale 0, maxScale 1, and containerConcurrency 1. Candidate detection, Tesseract integration, production PII masking/privacy validation, Android upload, Gemini/legal analysis, storage, authentication, encryption/key management, billing, and production provider authorization remain out of scope. Static validation is complete; actual Cloud Run build/deployment, targeted-region latency/quality, RAM/OOM, provider logs, cleanup/retention, cost, and actual regional behavior remain runtime evidence. active_track and next_step_id stay unchanged until measured targeted-region CPU evidence supports a separate product-direction change.
